Subject: Pilot onramp: success map & owners - SignalFlow evaluation

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and clear alignment on what success looks like. Below is a concise recap and a proposed 4-week pilot (POC) onramp so we can validate production metrics and hand off to ops smoothly. Please confirm owners and any constraints so we can lock dates.

Summary of ask
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference integration for SignalFlow's real-time summarization pipeline with production-like data.
- Duration: 4 weeks (test window) with a 2-week acceptance period.

Proposed success criteria (explicit)
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 220ms for 512-token average request size under baseline concurrency (30 rps)
- Cost: token cost below the threshold we discussed (target: <= $0.0006 / token) with batching/caching config applied
- Quality: F1 on extractive summarization > 0.72 on your core evaluation set (we will run the shared eval suite)
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during the test window (excluding scheduled maintenance)

POC plan (high-level)
- Week 0 (prep): account onboarding, test dataset ingest, sandbox endpoint provision
- Week 1: baseline run, tracing enabled, initial model variant + quantization settings
- Week 2: tuning (batching, KV cache), run evals and compare to baseline
- Week 3: scale test at 30-60 rps, measure p95 and cost; refine configs
- Week 4: acceptance run + handoff checklist; export logs and eval report

Owners / suggested contacts
- Redwood AE / PM: Jordan Blake (me) — program lead / commercial owner
- Redwood Solutions: Ben Carter — model integration and infra tests
- Redwood CSM: Camila Reyes — onboarding and success tracking
- SignalFlow PO: Maya Singh — product owner, acceptance sign-off
- SignalFlow CTO: Tom Reynolds — technical approvals and infra sign-off
- SignalFlow Security: Priya Desai — network/security requirements and SOC items

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can SignalFlow confirm Maya as PO and Priya for security? (reply with names/emails)
2) Is the proposed 4-week window (target start: week of 2027-07-18) workable? If not, propose date ranges.
3) Tom/Priya — please confirm any mandatory LL/NS/egress restrictions or a contact on network/infra to speed sandbox provisioning.

Attachments: signalflow_poc_plan_v1.pdf (POC runbook), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (SOC 2 high-level summary)
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Thanks — I’ll hold the proposed slot for now and start the internal capacity check once I hear back with owners.

Best,
Jordan Blake

Thanks Jordan — appreciated the recap. Couple of clarifications from our side after internal alignment:  

- Owners: Maya (PO) and I will own acceptance. Priya will lead security/network. Confirmed.
- Success thresholds: the p95 latency target is reasonable, but can you include a short-run at 80 rps for spike behavior? We want to understand tail latency under burst.
- Quality metric: we’ll provide the reference eval set this afternoon; F1 target looks OK, but we'll add a small tolerance for model variance.
- Compliance: Priya asked for a SOC2 summary and a short list of network ports/IP ranges we need to open for the sandbox. I attached our network workbook for your intake.

One ask on scheduling: our infra team is tight the week of 7/18 — can we start on 7/25 instead? That gives us time to get procurement sign-off.

Attached: signalflow_network_reqs.xlsx (network/security intake)

Thanks,
Tom
CTO | SignalFlow
